messages:
Maya: Quick heads up — we got space at the Community Hub meetup on Apr 14. Planning a mini-summit: booth, 2 short talks (15m), and a demo area. Need owners for booth ops, speaker submissions, swag order, and inbound lead routing.
Tom: Awesome. I can own booth ops and A/V. Need dimensions and power info.
Maya: Venue sent layout PDF: https://files.redwood.co/communityhub/layout.pdf — booth is 10x10, single 110V outlet, projector available in main room.
Sasha: I’ll take speaker submissions and curate the talk slots. Can we do a theme around "serving for scale" and a short benchmark demo?
Devon: I can handle demo runner and slide laptop. Also will set up a local staging model for the live demo.
Aisha: I’ll do swag. Thoughts: stickers, two styles of tees (M & L stock), and a promo card with a QR for the PLG sign-up flow.
Tom: For power we'll need a small UPS and HDMI switch. Ordering list: UPS x1, HDMI switch x1, spare HDMI cables. I can order if finance approves.
Maya: Budget for swag and shipping is $1.2k. Aisha, please draft SKU list and qtys by EOD Tuesday.
Aisha: Draft: stickers 500, tees 80 (mixed sizes), enamel pins 100, promo cards 500. ETA vendor quote by tomorrow.
Sasha: Speaker submission form: quick form here — https://forms.gle/community-hub-redwood — please push to our meetups list and partner orgs. I'll screen abstracts.
Devon: For inbound routing: recommend we capture leads with a QR -> Typeform -> Zap -> HubSpot queue. Tag source as "community_hub_apr14" and route to growth@redwood.com for 24h SLA.
Maya: Perfect. @events-bot add RSVP milestone: 50 RSVP reminder 1 week prior.
events-bot: RSVP milestone created — target 50 — reminder scheduled for 1769413456.
Tom: Can we print a small backup signage PDF? I'll drop a print-ready file in marketing drive by Fri.
Aisha: Vendor quote came back: tees $9 ea, stickers $0.10 ea, pins $2. Shipping + setup ~$220. Within budget.
Sasha: Accepted. I'll announce CfP to our newsletter and partners tomorrow. Who will moderate day-of panel?
Maya: I can moderate. Devon will do the demo run and Tom will help with Q&A tech. Sasha, please share accepted speaker bios by Apr 1.
Tom: Ordering list submitted to finance: UPS + HDMI + cables. PO# will be shared once approved.
Devon: Demo checklist (short): 1) local model packaged, 2) Docker image on staging, 3) fallback recorded video if latency spikes, 4) USB keyboard for live edits.
Aisha: Pls confirm tee sizes via this quick sheet: https://sheets.redwood.co/hub-tees — fill by Apr 4.
Maya: Great progress — next sync Tuesday 10am. Agenda: shipping timeline, final speaker list, lead routing test. :thumbsup:
